title: Nightly backup and the off-site copy
caption: deploy/scripts/backup.sh run by velexis-backup.timer at 02:30 UTC (RandomizedDelaySec 10 min). Settings in /etc/velexis/backup.env. The bucket, not the VM, enforces retention.

steps.label: refuse: shared data/config key, non-age1 lines, AGE-SECRET-KEY anywhere in /etc/velexis
age-encrypt velexis-db.dump, globals.sql, storage.tar.zst, redis-aof.tar.zst (data key); config.tar.zst + aide-baseline/ (config key); MANIFEST.txt
rclone copy --immutable (monthly/<yyyy-mm>/ on the 1st); rclone check
write /var/lib/velexis/backup-last-success; prune local sets older than 2 days
any failure → unit failed → one e-mail
every 5 min: marker older than 26 h → 'health check failed: backup-age'
